comments.note: Circular partial references (e.g., a partial that includes itself) are safe: the inner _INCLUDE_RE.sub calls load_partial (not _expand_partial recursively), so the cycle terminates after one more level, and the unresolved {{> name}} is reduced to {> name} by format_map. No infinite loop possible.
